title: Accenture Ventures Invests in AlphaSense; Accenture to Embed Platform in Client Offerings
summary: Accenture and AlphaSense announced an investment by Accenture Ventures in AlphaSense (terms undisclosed) and a partnership to help organizations build market intelligence into agentic workflows. The companies plan a joint effort to integrate AlphaSense into Accenture's client offerings across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, technology, and energy. The release cites more than 7,000 enterprise customers, including 90% of the S&P 100, and a content library of more than 500 million business documents.
whyItMatters: A global systems integrator distributing AlphaSense gives the platform — and the Tegus expert content inside it — a route into enterprise accounts that traditional expert networks reach only through direct sales.
